text: きびしい　たたかいを　つづけて　ほんとうの　つよさが　みに　つくわ

structure.jp: きびしい　たたかいを　つづけて
ほんとうの　つよさが

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to what follows and here shows what brings the result about. たたかいを　つづけて = 'by keeping up battles'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something. みに　つくわ = 'you gain it, you know'.
